title: North East CDC — Growth Fund & STARS
description: A five-part illustrated story following Lisa and her family, from everyday challenges to community support.

items.title: Meet Lisa and her family
items.alt: Illustrated introduction to Lisa, a housewife, with her five-year-old son and seven-year-old daughter.

items.title: The family’s sole breadwinner
items.alt: Illustration of Lisa’s husband driving a tow truck, identifying him as the family’s sole breadwinner.

items.title: Everyday essentials
items.alt: Lisa and her children worry about household expenses, including milk powder, diapers and school transport fares.

items.title: Support from North East CDC
items.alt: Lisa outside North East CDC, receiving support through the Growth Fund and STARS, illustrated with vouchers and a transport subsidy.

items.title: Make a difference today
items.alt: Lisa’s family in front of a pink heart, with a call to support low-income families through the Growth Fund and STARS.
